id.title: Selamat Malam, Semuanya
id.blurb: Cerita pendek untuk mengucapkan selamat malam kepada benda-benda di rumah.

pages.text: Hari sudah gelap. Tumi mengantuk.
Tumi bilang selamat malam kepada bola. Bola sudah berhenti menggelinding.
Tumi bilang selamat malam kepada sendok. Sendok sudah dicuci bersih.
Tumi bilang selamat malam kepada jendela. Di luar, bulan sudah naik.
Sekarang giliran kamu. Selamat malam.
pages.speaker: Tumi

en.title: Goodnight, Everyone
en.blurb: A short story for saying goodnight to the things around the house.

pages.text: It's dark outside now. Tumi is sleepy.
Tumi says goodnight to the ball. The ball has stopped rolling.
Tumi says goodnight to the spoon. The spoon is washed and clean.
Tumi says goodnight to the window. Outside, the moon is up.
Now it's your turn. Goodnight.
pages.speaker: Tumi

id.title: Suara Apa Itu
id.blurb: Cerita interaktif tentang menebak suara di sekitar rumah.

pages.text: Tumi mendengar sesuatu di luar jendela.
Kamu dengar suara apa?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi mendekat ke pintu. Ada suara lagi.
Kira-kira dari mana datangnya?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Ternyata suaranya dari halaman. Hujan baru saja berhenti.

en.title: What's That Sound
en.blurb: An interactive story about guessing sounds around the house.

pages.text: Tumi hears something outside the window.
What sound do you hear?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi moves closer to the door. There it is again.
Where do you think it's coming from?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: It was coming from the garden. The rain has just stopped.

id.title: Tumi Kehilangan Topinya
id.blurb: Cerita tentang kecewa, mencari, dan menemukan jalan keluar.

pages.text: Pagi ini Tumi tidak bisa menemukan topinya.
Tumi mencari di bawah bantal. Tidak ada.
Tumi mencari di dalam keranjang. Tidak ada juga.
Tumi duduk dan diam. Dadanya terasa berat.
Menurutmu Tumi merasa apa?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi menarik napas panjang. Lalu Tumi ingat satu tempat lagi.
Topinya ada di dekat pintu, tempat Tumi melepasnya kemarin.
Kadang kita menemukan sesuatu setelah berhenti sebentar.

en.title: Tumi Loses A Hat
en.blurb: A story about disappointment, searching, and finding a way through.

pages.text: This morning Tumi can't find the hat anywhere.
Tumi looks under the pillow. Not there.
Tumi looks in the basket. Not there either.
Tumi sits down and goes quiet. Everything feels heavy.
How do you think Tumi feels?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi takes a long breath. Then Tumi remembers one more place.
The hat is by the door, where Tumi left it yesterday.
Sometimes we find things after we stop for a moment.

id.title: Urutan Sebelum Tidur
id.blurb: Cerita tenang yang mengikuti rutinitas malam dari awal sampai akhir.

pages.text: Lampu sudah diredupkan. Malam sudah mulai.
Pertama, Tumi mandi. Airnya hangat.
Kedua, Tumi pakai baju tidur. Yang paling lembut.
Ketiga, Tumi sikat gigi. Atas, bawah, selesai.
Keempat, satu cerita. Cerita ini.
Terakhir, Tumi berbaring. Besok kita mulai lagi dari awal.

en.title: The Order Before Bed
en.blurb: A calm story that follows the evening routine from start to finish.

pages.text: The lights are low. The evening has started.
First, Tumi has a bath. The water is warm.
Second, Tumi puts on pyjamas. The softest ones.
Third, Tumi brushes teeth. Top, bottom, done.
Fourth, one story. This story.
Last, Tumi lies down. Tomorrow we start again from the beginning.

id.title: Dua Anak, Satu Bola
id.blurb: Cerita tentang berebut, dan menemukan cara supaya dua-duanya main.

pages.text: Tumi sedang main bola di halaman.
Lalu datang Nara. Nara juga mau main bola itu.
Mereka berdua memegang bolanya. Tidak ada yang mau melepas.
Menurutmu, apa yang sebaiknya mereka lakukan?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi melepas bolanya dulu. Nara menendang satu kali, lalu mengembalikannya.
Ternyata menendang bergantian lebih seru daripada menendang sendirian.
Sekarang halamannya ramai, dan bolanya cukup untuk berdua.

en.title: Two Children, One Ball
en.blurb: A story about wanting the same thing, and finding a way for both to play.

pages.text: Tumi is playing with a ball in the garden.
Then Nara arrives. Nara wants that ball too.
They both hold on to it. Neither wants to let go.
What do you think they should do?
pages.speaker: Tumi

pages.text: Tumi lets go first. Nara kicks it once, then passes it back.
It turns out kicking in turns is better than kicking alone.
Now the garden is busy, and one ball is enough for two.

id.title: Menara yang Roboh Tiga Kali
id.blurb: Cerita tentang mencoba lagi setelah gagal, dan mengubah satu hal setiap kali.

pages.text: Tumi mau membuat menara yang tinggi.
Menara pertama roboh. Bagian bawahnya terlalu kecil.
Tumi mencoba lagi dengan bawah yang lebih lebar. Roboh lagi, tapi lebih lambat.
Tumi berhenti sebentar. Tumi melihat bagian mana yang jatuh duluan.
Menara ketiga berdiri. Tidak terlalu tinggi, tapi berdiri.
Tumi tahu sekarang: ubah satu hal, lalu coba lagi.

en.title: The Tower That Fell Three Times
en.blurb: A story about trying again after failing, changing one thing each time.

pages.text: Tumi wants to build a tall tower.
The first tower falls. The bottom was too small.
Tumi tries again with a wider bottom. It still falls, but more slowly.
Tumi stops for a moment and looks at which part went first.
The third tower stands. Not very tall, but standing.
Now Tumi knows: change one thing, then try again.
